scope: Computer-use design and selected source inspection only; no product implementation

coverage_review.detail: Existing Playwright tools; selective observations; grounded versioned targets; actions with postconditions; bounded batches and partial effects; condition waits; session ownership and user handoff; memory/compact/modes; data boundaries; reuse and staged measurement.

source_inspection.limitations: No demonstrated performance bottleneck, live registered capability count, full native desktop support inventory, or product test pass claim.

runtime_validation.detail: Product build/test/lint/typecheck, browser/native desktop execution, login, actual MCP integration, GUI success rate, latency/cost/image/round-trip benchmarks and information-boundary E2E were not run.
